merge_policy: A status is not approval to merge. Resolve every required check and follow the listed order; keep each dependency PR separately reviewable.
candidate_check_evidence: At assessment, all 12 check runs on each of PRs #175-#182 had conclusion=failure. GitHub's job-log endpoint returned HTTP 404, so the causes could not be independently established. No PR has green candidate validation.

entries.package: 23-package npm group; includes @react-navigation/native, @react-navigation/native-stack, and @react-navigation/bottom-tabs 6.x to 7.x; cloudinary-react-native 1.0.x to 1.3.x
evidence: The PR changes the app's three React Navigation major-version ranges while package.json keeps Expo ~52.0.49, React Native 0.76.9, and React 18.3.1.
Navigation is used throughout src/navigation and screen components; a grouped lockfile refresh obscures which package change causes a regression.
The grouped PR overlaps the standalone Cloudinary upgrade in PR #182.
required_validation: Split the group into isolated updates; do not merge this aggregate as-is.
For a React Navigation 7 candidate, pass npm run test:compatibility, npx tsc --noEmit, npx expo export --platform web, npx expo-doctor, and npx expo prebuild --no-install --non-interactive.
Review all 23 package changes for security fixes before separating or deferring them.
entries.merge_order: After splitting, handle security-only transitive updates independently; test any navigation major upgrade separately from PR #182.

evidence: The application imports format, parseISO, isAfter, and isSameDay in appointment, dashboard, patient, and report screens.
This is a major-version change; the APIs used have a focused calendar behavior test, but the current PR has no passing candidate checks.
required_validation: Pass npm run test:compatibility and the mobile TypeScript, Expo web export, Expo Doctor, and prebuild gates against the PR lockfile.
Review date-only and ISO timestamp rendering for timezone-sensitive screens.
entries.merge_order: Independent of the backend updates; validate and merge separately.

evidence: The change remains within SQLAlchemy 2.x but raises the supported minimum.
The backend creates engines in storage.py and its durable stores; the repository has PostgreSQL persistence and production-boundary tests.
No candidate check passed.
required_validation: Pass the backend regression suite and PostgreSQL staging persistence tests with the candidate requirement.
Retain SQLite development behavior and assert PostgreSQL store initialization succeeds.
entries.merge_order: Test separately from PR #180 first; then run PostgreSQL integration with both resolved dependencies.

evidence: The upgrade crosses Redis client's major versions and raises the production minimum.
backend/rate_limit.py uses the synchronous Redis.from_url, incr, and expire methods; its production failure-closed behavior must remain intact.
No candidate check passed, and current PR gates do not install Redis or exercise a Redis server.
required_validation: Run a Redis 8.1+ integration smoke test for URL connection, INCR/EXPIRE limits, and production fail-closed behavior before merge.
entries.merge_order: Keep separate from database-driver changes; do not merge until an actual Redis-server integration result is green.

evidence: The app is on Expo SDK 52 with React Native 0.76.9; the candidate jumps the Expo module from the SDK 52 generation to 57.
ScreeningReportScreen.tsx calls the legacy documentDirectory and moveAsync APIs.
The candidate PR lockfile retains expo-file-system 18.0.12 nested under Expo while installing 57.0.7 at the app root, leaving two incompatible generations in the tree.
required_validation: Do not merge this package bump independently. Use the SDK 52-compatible expo-file-system version or plan a coordinated Expo SDK upgrade.
For an SDK upgrade, migrate the file APIs and pass TypeScript, web export, Expo Doctor, native prebuild, and native platform builds.
entries.merge_order: Last, only as part of a deliberate Expo SDK/RN upgrade. Never combine with an SDK 52 app unchanged.

evidence: The constraint stays on Psycopg 3, and backend/storage.py normalizes postgres:// and postgresql:// URLs to postgresql+psycopg://.
PostgreSQL 16 staging tests exercise durable stores through this dialect.
No candidate check passed.
required_validation: Pass backend regression and PostgreSQL staging persistence tests using the candidate psycopg version.
Verify all store engines report PostgreSQL and use the psycopg dialect.
entries.merge_order: Test separately from PR #177 first; then run PostgreSQL integration with both resolved dependencies.

evidence: The app is Expo SDK 52 / React Native 0.76.9 with newArchEnabled=true and uses react-native-svg-transformer.
The candidate release notes include native Android/iOS and React Native props changes; JavaScript-only typechecking cannot establish native compatibility.

entries.merge_order: After SDK compatibility is established; keep separate from PR #179 and any React Native major upgrade.

evidence: The release notes for 1.2.0 explicitly add Expo 52/53 support, matching the app's Expo 52 generation.

PR #175 also changes Cloudinary, and no candidate check passed.
required_validation: Confirm the dependency remains unused or exercise its installed native component before retaining it.
Pass npm ci, mobile TypeScript/export/doctor/prebuild gates on this PR's lockfile.
